END_OF_SERVICE: Lino twasika kumamanino abubelesi oobu bwalo bubelesya maiwe amuluwo asumpukide. Inga mwabaana makani ambi andiswe kufumbwa ciindi kwiinda mukutyanka kantu kaku tyanka anselelo aawa.
THANKS:
Twalumba kubelesya TalkToLoop.org kuti igwii leynu lyvwiingwe akuba akucinca kulikabotu. tuyakukalanganya aku katuma kaamba na kano kanu mumoola ataindi kumakumi obilo atosanwe, cakufwabana. tuyakumitumila bwiinguzi twatambula kambo.

Mbubo.

kutalika alimwi amutyanke 'Loop' antela mutyanke anse 😃.
